## 4. New finding — D-CAP.3-3 (P1 leg-contract drift)

P1's `/v/working @390` assert predates **P1.19's** shipped contract. The leg accepts only
redirect→`/p/<slug>`, a `[data-page-mount]` editor, or `[data-phone-blocked]`; the product
deliberately serves a **reader-only Page** at phone width (`isPhoneRequest` → `compact` +
`readOnly`, no collab wire, no version rail — `server.ts` P1.19 branch; §10.1's capability
split holds: nothing editable). Prod renders exactly that (`data-ide="1"`,
`data-collab-url=""`, read-only markers) → the leg fails on `/p/<slug>/v/working` with
"neither the project page nor the §10.1 note". First exposure: the 44px defect
(D-CAP.2-3, now verified fixed) failed the step earlier, so this leg never reached its
assert before today. Filed per the defect rule — the leg's accept-set needs the P1.19
reader surface (or the surface needs `data-phone-blocked`); P1 stays `expected:"green"`
per the N4/N9 precedent (a green step's outstanding defect stays green and fails).
